title: Updating the source code register
statement: For any machine state $st$ and natural number $k$, replacing coordinate $8$ of its register vector by $k$ yields the register vector of the state obtained from $st$ by setting its source code register $U$ to $k$.
replaced:
Let a machine state be a tuple of seventeen natural-number registers, and let its
register vector list these registers in order, with the source code in coordinate $8$.
Replacing that coordinate of the register vector by $k$ gives the register vector of the
state obtained by setting the source code to $k$.
